Prefer a complete constant-pattern type test at an enclosing expression boundary; retain primitive and structured type tests and every original expression alternative.
Retain the complete constant-pattern interpretation in nested expression contexts when equivalent recursive derivations also expose the type-test fallback.
Preserve a complete constant type-test pattern inside a parenthesized expression before following member access, while retaining every original parenthesized expression.

Preserve a complete nullable type test before an enclosing expression boundary instead of committing to its question mark as an incomplete conditional operator; retain every original expression alternative.
Preserve the qualified type interpretation of a complete positional subpattern without changing constant interpretations in ordinary expression patterns.
